description.value: Private RV park on the west shore of Swan Lake with tent sites looking out over calm water; free pedal boats, canoes, and a rowboat make this a laid-back lakeside stop, though the marshy shores mean paddling out for a proper swim. Coin showers, laundry, and Wi-Fi on site.

address.value: 7235 Old Kamloops Road, Vernon BC, V1H 1W6

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms this is an active campground accepting 2026 reservations, located at 7235 Old Kamloops Road, Vernon BC. Key amenities confirmed from website text: coin-operated showers, small laundromat, free wi-fi, tent sites with water hookup. OSM tags corroborate wifi (internet_access=yes, fee=no), water supply, and washing machine. No specific hiker/biker sites, cyclist discounts, or bike-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere.
concerns: OSM record missing address and phone; website provides both (7235 Old Kamloops Road, Vernon BC; 250-545-2300)
Primarily an RV park; tent sites exist but are secondary to the RV offering
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate campground with tent sites near Vernon, well-suited for touring cyclists on the Okanagan corridor. Active for 2026 season with confirmed reservations.

wow_evidence: free pedal boats, canoes, and a rowboat... coin showers, laundry, and Wi-Fi on site
